primitives.verbatim_quote: Results reveal a statistically significant but modest negative association between team-level fatigue and shot volume (p < 0.001, R2 = 0.12), corresponding to an estimated decrease of approximately one shot per game for each unit increase in ACWR.
primitives.assumptions: Linear relationship between ACWR and shot volume; constant team composition and tactical structure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When ACWR exceeds 1.5, shot volume begins to decline significantly.

primitives.name: Fatigue-Adjusted Expected Goals Quality
primitives.verbatim_quote: A weaker, non-significant relationship (p = 0.1, R2 = 0.007) was observed between team fatigue and average shot expected goals (xG), suggesting a limited reduction in the creation of high-quality shooting opportunities under conditions of elevated workload.
primitives.assumptions: Shot quality independent of fatigue beyond threshold; no confounding variables.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Non-significant effect when p > 0.05; minimal impact below ACWR = 1.2.
